    AI Overview
    Tomislav and Zvonimir Ivisic are 7-foot-plus Croatian twin brothers playing for the University of Illinois (2025–26), creating a rare and dominant tall frontcourt. Known for their combined scoring, rebounding, and shot-blocking skills, they reunited at Illinois after previous stints in European professional leagues and separate US collegiate teams (Kentucky/Arkansas for Zvonimir). 
    This video shows the Ivisic twins discussing their childhood and motivation for playing basketball:
    57s
    Big Ten Network
    YouTube• Jan 27, 2026
    Background & Key Details 
    • The Twins:
      Zvonimir "Z" Ivisic (7'2") and Tomislav Ivisic (7'1").
    • Birthdate/Origin: Born August 9, 2003, in Vitez, Bosnia and Herzegovina.
    • Style: Both are versatile big men who can protect the rim and shoot three-pointers, complementing each other's games.
    • Career Path: The duo grew up playing together in Croatia and Montenegro before spending time apart, with Zvonimir arriving first at Kentucky (2023–2024) and then transferring to Illinois, while Tomislav joined Illinois prior to the 2024–25 season. 
    2025-26 Season Highlights 
    • Impact: They helped lead Illinois to a deep 2026 NCAA tournament run (Elite Eight/Sweet 16).
    • Performance: Tomislav was a key contributor in the NCAA tournament with strong rebounding and shooting. Zvonimir is considered one of the top shot-blockers.
    • Role: The two are known to play together, providing the Illini with a unique, high-skill frontcourt rotation. 
    Differences in Personality 
    • They are known to have different personalities, with one described as flashier while the other is more consistent, though they are very close and share a "twin telepathy".
